slot.brief: Assign R/S configuration to a molecule drawn as a Fischer projection.

stem:
What is the absolute configuration of the stereogenic centres in this Fischer projection?
$$
\begin{array}{c}
\text{CH}_2\text{OH}\\
|\\
\text{H}-\text{C}_2-\text{Br}\\
|\\
\text{Cl}-\text{C}_3-\text{H}\\
|\\
\text{CH}_3
\end{array}
$$

verdicts.working: At C2, priorities are Br > C3 > CH2OH > H; the 1→2→3 order is clockwise, but H is on a horizontal bond, so invert: S. At C3, priorities are Cl > C2 > CH3 > H; the 1→2→3 order is clockwise, and horizontal H again requires inversion: S.

working:
At C2: priorities are Br $>\text{C}_3>\text{CH}_2\text{OH}>\text{H}$. The $1\to2\to3$ order is clockwise; H is horizontal, so C2 is S.
At C3: priorities are Cl $>\text{C}_2>\text{CH}_3>\text{H}$. The $1\to2\to3$ order is clockwise; H is horizontal, so C3 is S.
Configuration: $(2S,3S)$.

Independent check: At C2, priorities are Br > C3 > CH2OH > H; the 1→2→3 order is clockwise, but H is on a horizontal bond, so invert: S. At C3, priorities are Cl > C2 > CH3 > H; the 1→2→3 order is clockwise, and horizontal H again requires inversion: S.
